entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Balkrishna Royal - Advocate for the applicant.

Ms. Sudha Shrivastava, learned Senior Counsel with Sh
 Ansari - Advocate for the objector.

Shri Rahul Solanki - Government Advocate for the resp
 Order

1. This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 / Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail in connection with Crime No.730/25 registered at P.S. Khajarana, Indore (M.P.) for offence punishable under Section 109,
296 of BNS, 2023 and Section 25, 27 of the Arms Act.

The applicant is in custody since 13.9.2025.
2.
As per the prosecution case, applicant caused gun-shot injury on the wrist of the injured.

Thereafter P.S. Khajrana, District Indore registered the offence under Section 109, 296 of BNS,
2023 and Section 25, 27 of the Arms Act.

3. Counsel for the applicant submitted that complainant has already NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:37981 2 MCRC-54936-2025 been discharged from the hospital and injured sustained injury on the non vital part of the body.
Applicant's counsel further submitted that complainant / injured came to the home of applicant with some obscene photographs in his mobile of his daughter, then this incident has taken place.

He has also submitted that one case registered against the complainant / injured under Section 376, 376(2)(N), 458, 294, 323, 506 of IPC at Crime No.732/25 on 13/09/2025 and there is no query report in the charge sheet that as per the case registered against complainant/injured under Section 376 of IPC at Crime No.732/25, in which prosecutrix stated in the version of FIR that injured/Arjun came to the home of applicant with two other persons and tried to took her daughter forcefully.
Then in such circumstances applicant being as a father, no option left to him to save the daughter.

Looking to the peculiar circumstances, this particular case fall under the category of Right to Private Defence of the Body u/S 96 of IPC / u/S 34 Sunil Patidar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 29 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/188091958/
1 of BNS, 2023.

entities.text: Sunil Patidar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 29 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Under Section 35 of BNS 2023, right to private defence of the body and property,
every person has a right, subject to the restriction contained in Section 37 to defend - (a) His own body and the body of any other person, against any offence, affecting human body.
4. Counsel for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has opposed the prayer and submitted that no case for grant of bail is made out.
5. Learned Senior Counsel for the objector vehemently opposed the bail application and stated that dispute is regarding the money between the complainant and son of applicant.

6. Having considered the rival submissions and on perusal of the case NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:37981 3 MCRC-54936-2025 diary and taking note of the fact that right now investigation is over and charge sheet has been filed, no further interrogation of the applicant is required and he is in jail since 13.9.2025, without commenting much more on the merits of the case,
this Court is inclined to grant bail to the applicant.
7. Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application filed by the applicant is allowed.

The applicant is directed to be released on bail upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a direction that he shall remain present before the court concerned during trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
Certified copy as per rules.
